title: Mandatory 215-system NEXY audit registry prompt v9
scope: Produce a standalone Thai audit-only system prompt embedding all 215 NEXY systems supplied by the user as a mandatory registry, requiring re-verification against the attached design file and current GitHub, status tables, repeated audits, and executor commands for missing/failing/current-required systems.
inputs_summary: User supplied the definitive 215-system inventory spanning core/UI, DOC-C/vNEXT, vault/memory, sovereign/universe, constitutional layers, Game/NCF, L1o, Lo3/V-SWARM, Lo2, robotics/RCL, final 10-layer architecture, and cross-system mechanisms.
actions: Embedded all 215 system identifiers and names as mandatory minimum registry
Separated seed observations from current audit verdicts
Added scope/authority classification and governance conflict handling
Added exhaustive status tables and multi-pass clean audit closure

claims_proofs.claim: The audit denominator must include all 215 supplied systems.
claims_proofs.proof: Direct user instruction in current message.

claims_proofs.claim: Supplied statuses must be treated as seed observations, not immutable current truth.
claims_proofs.proof: Project truth law requires fresh verification against current spec and HEAD.

tests_results: Prompt-generation only; no NEXY implementation audit performed.
successes: Created full standalone 215-system audit prompt architecture.
decisions: No protected branch rule included because user removed that constraint.
Only current-required/current-law/current-design systems may trigger CREATE/FIX; excluded/deferred/historical systems trigger governance review rather than automatic implementation.
Systems implemented outside DOC-C scope use GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED rather than PASS.
unresolved: Actual current branch and HEAD must be resolved when the audit prompt runs.
Current authority of some broad architecture families must be re-resolved from the design file.
risks: Blindly creating every missing named system would violate current scope where design marks systems out/deferred.
limits: This task creates the audit prompt, not the actual audit results.
next_actions: Use the generated prompt in the dedicated NEXY audit chat with the design file attached and GitHub connected.
dependencies: GitHub read access to target NEXY repository
